description.text: The seventh XY set, released on 12 August 2015 with 100 cards: 98 and two secret Trainers. It centers on the Mythical Hoopa, as Hoopa-EX, beside Mega Tyranitar-EX, Mega Ampharos-EX and Mega Sceptile-EX, and its secret rares include Shiny Primal Kyogre-EX, Primal Groudon-EX and Mega Rayquaza-EX. It brought more Ancient Traits and new Special Energy cards.
